recommendations.Workmanship: Audit repeat jobs, callbacks, and post-service quality checks.
recommendations.Reliability / No-show: Review scheduling, dispatch, and appointment-confirmation controls.
recommendations.Timeliness: Investigate cycle-time bottlenecks and customer delay notifications.
recommendations.Pricing / Billing: Review estimate accuracy, change-order approvals, and fee disclosure.
recommendations.Communication: Strengthen callback ownership, status updates, and escalation procedures.
recommendations.Professionalism / Trust: Review conduct complaints and reinforce customer-service standards.
recommendations.Safety / Property Damage: Escalate for human review and investigate the reported safety/property-damage signal.
recommendations.Warranty / Follow-up: Audit warranty response times, repeat repairs, and closure tracking.
recommendations.No dictionary match: Perform manual review and expand the domain phrase dictionary.

routine_monitoring: Routine monitoring. The review is below the management-attention threshold; no manual investigation is required.
disclaimer: Review-based risk signals for human investigation. They do not verify customer allegations or establish misconduct, liability or safety violations.
